categories.main_business_segments: Sunko Ink Co., Ltd. primarily operates in specialty chemicals, polymer materials, and plant protection agrochemicals. Its product lines include plastic additives such as antioxidants, flame retardants, nucleating agents, crosslinking agents, electronic chemicals, thermoplastic elastomers (TPU, TPV), polyols, and synthetic resins. The company also engages in contract manufacturing for agrochemical active ingredients and develops environmentally friendly and high-performance polymer products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes organic synthesis and polymer chemistry expertise for product development. Manufacturing processes include batch production for specialty chemicals, polymerization and pelletizing for polymers, and crystallization, filtration, and drying for agrochemical intermediates. Recent R&D focuses on halogen-free flame retardants, triazine UV absorbers with environmentally friendly processes, dynamic crosslinking of thermoplastic vulcanizates, and foam-grade TPU materials. Emphasis is placed on green chemistry, energy-saving production, and recycling technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Sunko serves international chemical, plastics, electronics, footwear, and agricultural sectors. Key customers include global chemical and agrochemical companies, electronics manufacturers requiring flame retardants and PCB chemicals, and footwear brands adopting TPU materials for sustainable shoe components. The company maintains strong OEM/ODM relationships with major global players, especially in agrochemical contract manufacturing and polymer applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taiwan with multiple manufacturing sites and sales offices. Its sales markets include domestic Taiwan and export regions such as the Americas, Europe, and Asia. Export sales have increased notably in Europe and the Americas, reflecting a diversified international customer base. The company also sources raw materials from Japan, Korea, China, Europe, and India.
categories.supply_chain_position: Sunko operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the chemical supply chain. It manufactures specialty chemical additives and polymer materials from imported raw materials and supplies these to downstream manufacturers in plastics, electronics, footwear, and agrochemical industries. The company also provides contract manufacturing services for agrochemical active ingredients, positioning itself as a key midstream supplier with some downstream customization capabilities.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on continuous innovation, environmental sustainability, workplace safety, and corporate governance. R&D priorities include developing high-performance, environmentally friendly specialty chemicals such as halogen-free flame retardants and triazine UV absorbers, advanced polymer materials with recycling and foaming capabilities, and customized BMI resins for electronics. Long-term plans emphasize low-pollution, high-value products, energy-saving processes, and diversification into related chemical fields supported by patents and technical services.
categories.revenue_model: Sunko generates revenue primarily through product sales of specialty chemicals, polymer materials, and agrochemical intermediates. It also earns income from contract manufacturing services for agrochemical active ingredients. The company focuses on expanding sales volume and market share through customer relationship management, new product development, and marketing of proprietary patented products.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include global chemical giants such as BASF, SI Group, Covestro, Huntsman, Lubrizol, and regional players in China and Korea. Sunko positions itself as a mid-sized specialty chemical and polymer manufacturer with strengths in customized, high-value products and strong OEM partnerships. It competes by focusing on product differentiation, environmental compliance, and technical service to maintain customer loyalty amid intense price competition and overcapacity in the industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, Sunko reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$2.29 billion, a 4.6% increase from the previous year, but incurred a net loss of NT$182.6 million. The company’s total assets were about NT$3.42 billion with shareholders’ equity of NT$1.94 billion. Despite recent losses due to market oversupply and pricing pressures, the company is investing around NT$46.5 million annually in R&D to drive future growth and product innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Sunko emphasizes high-quality, customized specialty chemicals and polymer materials with advanced performance and environmental benefits. Its value proposition includes proprietary patented technologies, environmentally friendly production processes, and strong technical support services. The company differentiates itself by developing innovative flame retardants, UV absorbers, and recyclable polymer products tailored to customer needs, enabling clients to meet increasingly stringent environmental regulations and sustainability goals.
